authorization: 用户要求细节更少一点、更可爱，重画前两张；仅生成两张原图供检查。
referenceMode: Each sheet uses its own previous raw image as the only input.
commonPrompt:
REDRAW the attached Furo action sheet in a SLIGHTLY SIMPLER, CUTER, SOFTER 2D cartoon illustration style. Make a visible but restrained reduction in detail. The attached image is the exact previous version to revise, with four actions in a 2 by 2 layout. Keep those SAME four actions, their row-major positions, the complete poses, the props that identify each action and Furo's character identity. Create one new finished sheet, not a before/after comparison.
The character anatomy in the source derives from the approved Furo standing turnaround. Preserve that anatomy: very large rounded head, compact white mascot torso, short rounded white forepaws, very short legs and modest dark-brown foot tips. Keep the pale dusty pink bob and its essential silhouette, black horizontal side clips and black geometric bang clips, rose-red eyes, cream-white face and tiny w-shaped mouth. Standing actions retain the upright white torso and small grounded brown foot ends; do not turn them into crouching or seated figures. Seated actions remain seated. Do not enlarge the feet, add paw-pad details, long limbs, a neck, fingers, animal ears, a tail, clothes or new ornaments.
STYLE CHANGE, IMPORTANT: Use soft pastel flat fills with only ONE restrained clean shadow shape when needed on a major form. Remove airbrushed shading, dense gradients, texture and tiny reflective details. The white body should be mostly a clean warm-white shape without gray modeling strokes or toe shading. Hair should read as one soft pink mass with its essential bang shapes; remove redundant interior hair lines and the row of glossy white dots. At most one very small simple hair highlight. Eyes should use simple rose-red color blocks and one small white highlight each, without layered glossy reflections. Keep the original eye scale and facial structure while making the expression gentler. Blush is two small soft pink marks, not a broad glossy gradient. Use rounded, steady dark-brown outlines, slightly fuller and simpler than in the source, with fewer short interior strokes. Preserve enough form to look like finished game art; this is not a rough sketch or an icon reduced to featureless blobs.
CUTENESS: Gentle rounded cheeks, tiny friendly mouths and soft readable expressions. Negative states should look mildly needy or sleepy, never grim, frightening or dramatically distressed. Make small props rounded and visually simple, using very few internal lines. No added stars, hearts, labels or decorative marks unless explicitly part of the requested action.
LAYOUT: Exactly FOUR illustrations in the original 2 by 2 arrangement: TOP LEFT, TOP RIGHT, BOTTOM LEFT, BOTTOM RIGHT. Square 1:1 image. Keep consistent head size and line weight across all four drawings. Complete uncropped characters and props inside their own cells with generous plain white margins and clear white gutters. Pure white background, no floor shadow, room, frames, grid, text, letters, numbers, watermark or presentation decorations. The output is the ORIGINAL revised artwork for human review; no composite comparison, crop panels or exploded layers.

cells.name: 日常坐姿
cells.description: Same calm sitting pose as source. Soft rose-red eyes, tiny friendly w-smile, relaxed small forepaws and modest brown foot tips. Simplify the hair shine and remove gray shading from the white torso.

cells.name: 饥饿
cells.description: Same hungry seated pose: one forepaw near the belly, other holding one empty cream plate at the side. Small pleading open mouth and gentle brows. The plate has a plain cream fill, one outer contour and just one simple rim line, no metallic highlights or multiple rings.

cells.name: 干净的难过
cells.description: Same seated sad pose, clean face and clean body. Slightly drooping brows and a tiny downturned mouth, mild gentle disappointment. No tears, grime or heavy shadows. Rounded simple forms.

cells.name: 需要清洁
cells.description: Same seated pose needing a wash. Use only a few broad smooth flat brown mud patches on cheek, hair end and belly or paw. No speckled texture, brush-grain, clusters of tiny dots or extra stains. Soft slightly embarrassed expression.

cells.name: 困倦
cells.description: Same seated sleepy yawn, one rounded forepaw near the small open mouth, gently half-closed eyes. Very simple warm-white torso, modest brown foot ends. No books, glasses, sleep text or extra effects.

cells.name: 生病
cells.description: Same seated unwell pose with a very simple white thermometer at the mouth and a tiny red indicator line. Mildly tired eyes and small pink cheeks; at most one small tear per eye. No complex instrument markings, dramatic crying, red cross or text.

cells.name: 睡眠
cells.description: Same sleeping pose on a pale blue pillow beneath a pale blue quilt, eyes peacefully closed. Keep two simple white cloud motifs. Use broad flat colors, no quilt texture, extra fold lines, shine streaks or sleep text. Entire pillow-and-quilt silhouette visible.

cells.name: 开心
cells.description: Same joyful STANDING pose as the source: both short forepaws raised, happy closed eyes and a small cheerful open mouth. Preserve the upright torso, short legs and TWO SMALL grounded brown foot tips from the approved model. No crouching, large oval soles, body shading or added sparkles.
